transcript.text: I need to flag a critical operational constraint before Riley finalizes the flag settings. While tracing a separate permissions bug yesterday, I found that 23 legacy admin endpoints update permissions without emitting the invalidation event consumed by the new cache. I haven't filed the adapter work yet because I was still confirming which endpoints still use that path. The rollout plan must include a binding commitment to build and verify an invalidation adapter for those 23 endpoints before expanding beyond the initial cohort.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical operational constraint from the load rehearsal I ran this morning. Invalidation-queue propagation measured at a 9-minute p95, and the queue stays within its safe operating limit only if the first rollout cohort is capped at 10 percent. Additionally, the authorization cache lifetime must be set to exactly 300 seconds for this rollout. I haven't updated the rollout ticket yet because the rehearsal finished after the change-control review began.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical operational constraint from customer support. During a support-case review, I confirmed that all 11 SCIM-managed enterprise accounts use an admin workflow that cannot yet explain delayed permission changes. Those accounts must be excluded from the first rollout cohort, and a support playbook must be prepared before they are enabled. I hadn't posted this finding yet because the cases were being reassigned between support queues.
transcript.speaker: A4

Prepare a customer support playbook for delayed permission changes before any SCIM-managed enterprise accounts are enabled in the rollout.
